## Requirements

1. `audience` sender-constraint verification (string/audience
   matching) — the channel verifies instead of refusing.
2. `dpop` keeps the typed `SenderConstraintUnmet` refusal with the
   reason recorded — no fabricated proof-of-possession.
3. A canary channel registered in every Stage-3 environment image
   manifest (§5g.3 §9; the §05h I3 `environment` member) through the
   broker's existing canary machinery.
4. DF-S1.13-1 / DF-S1.13-3 discharged or reduced to dated residuals.

## Plan / implementation

1. `hh-secrets` (`broker.rs`, `channel.rs`, `errors.rs`): `bind` refuses
   `dpop` `SenderConstraintUnmet` on **every** delivery mode (moved out
   of the `minted_scoped`-only gate — an unverifiable constraint never
   silently admits); `audience` admits at `bind` (injected modes fenced
   by `destinations ⊆ channel.destinations`; `minted_scoped` carries the
   binding into `mint`); `mint` refuses `Refused{out_of_scope}` when the
   requested audience ∉ the binding's declared destinations — never
   mints an unverifiable claim. ADR-0342 D1/D2.
2. `hh-env` (`record.rs`): `CanaryChannel{channel_id, spec}` +
   `EnvironmentRecord.canary_channels` — identity-bearing
   (`identify().semantic("canary_channels", …)`; a different canary set
   is a different image). ADR-0342 D3.
3. `hh-env` (`driver.rs`, `errors.rs`, `events.rs`, `handle.rs`):
   `check_canary_manifest` (Stage-3 `needs_adapter` class + no canary ⇒
   `CanaryManifest{missing}`; non-`canary:true` member ⇒ `non_canary`;
   declared canary + no broker ⇒ `broker_absent`) +
   `register_declared_canaries` (`register_channel` per member before
   the adapter stands a remote up; `ChannelExists` under an identical
   `canary:true` spec is satisfied — same-image re-provision / derived
   child on the shared broker — under a different spec it is a
   `register:<id>` manifest conflict). `EnvHandle.canary_channels`
   records the ids; `derive` inherits the parent's set;
   `action.environment.provisioned` carries `canary_channels[]` (ids
   only — CC2). ADR-0342 D3/D4.
4. `hh-embed` (`open.rs`, `durability_ops.rs`): provision call sites
   pass the run's `credential_broker`; the local-host record's
   `canary_channels` is `vec![]` (non-Stage-3 — permitted).
5. Batteries: `hh-secrets/tests/r2_10.rs` (4), `hh-env/tests/r2_10.rs`
   (10); fixture updates across `s4_13`/`s5_8`/`r2_4`/`r2_6`/`r2_9`/
   `acceptance`/`durable_recovery`/`k4_cache`/`kill_point_battery`/
   `s4_14b`/`helper_live` (the new record member + broker arg).
6. ADR-0342; DEFERRALS markers; BACKLOG BL-19; COVERAGE R-2.8.3;
   closeout docs.
